<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_INQ_IP"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/inq-ip">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TransactionDataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DataTransmission" name="Data transmission"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_INQ_IP">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ" processRef="Process_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request"
                      name="Transaction data request"
                      sourceRef="Task_INQ_TransmitRequest"
                      targetRef="Start_IP_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Data"
                      name="Data transmission"
                      sourceRef="Task_IP_TransmitData"
                      targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection"
                      name="Rejection"
                      sourceRef="Task_IP_SendRejection"
                      targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveRejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_INQ" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_INQ_TransmitRequest"
                   name="Transmit transaction data request to IP"
                   messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_INQ_WaitForAnswer"
                            name="Wait for IP answer"
                            eventGatewayType="Exclusive"
                            gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_INQ_ReceiveData"
                      name="Receive data from IP"
                      messageRef="Message_DataTransmission"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_INQ_ReceiveRejection"
                      name="Receive rejection from IP"
                      messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_INQ_DataReceived" name="Data received"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_INQ_RejectionReceived" name="Rejection received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_1" sourceRef="Start_INQ" targetRef="Task_INQ_TransmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_2" sourceRef="Task_INQ_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Gateway_INQ_WaitForAnswer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_3" name="Data transmission" sourceRef="Gateway_INQ_WaitForAnswer" targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_4" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_INQ_WaitForAnswer" targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_5" sourceRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveData" targetRef="End_INQ_DataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_6" sourceRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_INQ_RejectionReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_IP_Request" name="Transaction data request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_IP_Request"
                                  messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IP_CheckRequest" name="Check INQ request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IP_ExaminationOutcome"
                           name="Examination outcome?"
                           gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_TransmitData"
                   name="Transmit data to INQ"
                   messageRef="Message_DataTransmission"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_SendRejection"
                   name="Send rejection to INQ"
                   messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_IP_DataTransmitted" name="Data transmitted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_IP_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_1" sourceRef="Start_IP_Request" targetRef="Task_IP_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_2" sourceRef="Task_IP_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_IP_ExaminationOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_3" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_IP_TransmitData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_4" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_IP_SendRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_5" sourceRef="Task_IP_TransmitData" targetRef="End_IP_DataTransmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_6" sourceRef="Task_IP_SendRejection" targetRef="End_IP_RequestRejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
